summary: Wide dirt verge on a through road, with houses 15 m away and steep.
reasons: Dirt verge with cars parked on it
Houses 15-22 m away on both sides

drivers.seclusion: Houses 15 m and 22 m away on the section's side and homes across the road; neighbours would see a van.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt verge meets the road edge and room for a van off the lane; a car is parked on it.
drivers.traffic: Through road with lane markings and moving traffic, but the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: A few cars park on the dirt here; the rest of the kerb has almost none.

flags: Steep: about 9% over this section, 8% mean overall
Houses 15-22 m away on both sides
sun_shade: Open dirt with a street tree at the uphill end; morning sun from the east.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge is signed or fenced

best_section.where: Jerrang Street, south side, on the bare dirt verge before the junction at the downhill end
